# .github working instructions

- Follow the root instruction-update policy and the nearest parent instructions.
- This file covers `.github/` and its descendants unless a more specific instruction file applies.
- Read the owning contracts below before changing behavior, including affected cross-domain consumers.

## Validation

- Keep the DeliDev desktop checks-phase synthetic sidebar geometry check mandatory, with isolated pinned browser tooling and source-revision evidence. Follow the [workflow contract](../docs/repository-workflow-contract.md); browser fixtures do not establish native acceptance.
